rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and zip, and looked up relevant orders and product variants. However, it executed exchanges via write actions without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates policy. For the jigsaw, the agent also selected a specific replacement (500-piece, art, intermediate) without confirming the original piece count or difficulty to ensure the “500 fewer pieces” and “same difficulty” requirements were satisfied, and it chose a “fancier theme” without user confirmation of the exact theme. Finally, it claimed the requests had been processed post hoc rather than confirming before making changes. These issues constitute clear policy breaches, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
